MSC WORLD EUROPA WELCOME TO THE FUTURE OF CRUISING Imagine the future of cruising and discover it in the revolutionary MSC World Class fleet. MSC World Europa was the first ship in this trailblazing new generation. With their futuristic silhouette, signature plumb bow and Y-shaped aft, the ships in the MSC World class will looks like nothing else at sea, cutting through the water with ease and grace. To complete this revolution, we have also developed an immersive guest experience, so on MSC World Europa, guests can look forward to a holiday like no other. It’s a new class of emotions, for the future of cruising. Another significant step forward in MSC’s commitment to environmental stewardship. MSC World Europa features advanced technology and brings MSC’s fleet closer to our aspiration of “net-zero greenhouse-gas emissions across our fleet”. The LNGLiquified Natural Gas-powered engines ensure: - 99% reduction of SOx emissions1 - 85% reduction of NOx emissions1 - 25% reduction in greenhouse gasses (GHG) - Major elimination of particulate matter in exhaust undefined LNG-powered Ground-breaking design From her stunning silhouette to her signature plumb bow, the futuristic MSC World Europa is as visually striking as she is innovative. Her unique Y-shaped open aft leads to the 104m long outdoor World Promenade, with incredible panoramic ocean views. The promenade also features the record breaking, longest dry slide at sea – the Venom Drop @ The Spiral – an 11-deck high stainless-steel masterpiece, unique in the cruise industry. undefined Ground-breaking design Futuristic cruise experience The future of cruising isn’t just about technology: it’s about the experience too. MSC World Europa was designed to elevate the delights of a traditional cruise ship to entirely new levels. From her sleek interior design to her 13 dining venues to her thrilling entertainment offerings, the onboard experience is like no other cruise ship. Relax in the scenic Panorama Lounge, experience the excitement of the futuristic Luna Park Arena, or lose yourself in the iconic kinetic LED dome in the indoor World Galleria. undefined Futuristic cruise experience On-board experience There’s something for everyone on board MSC World Europa, from the largest waterpark in our fleet, to bumper cars, and our new surprise street performances. And with 7 swimming pools spread across the ship, including one with a sliding roof, there’s always space to relax by the water and pool deck. For families with children, the award-winning MSC kids club features state-of-the-art facilities inside a dedicated area of the ship, with a range of kids’ clubs and tailor-made programs for every age group. undefined On-board experience MSC Aurea Spa Restore body and soul in the MSC Aurea Spa large 1012 m2, a luxurious Balinese spa on board on MSC World Europa. Comprising a thermal area, Gym, Beauty salon and Barber shop, it offers a wealth of wellness and beauty treatments to relax, pamper and revitalise you. undefined MSC Aurea Spa MSC Yacht Club Luxury of a private club, while enjoying access to the myriad recreation and entertainment possibilities that the rest of the ship affords. The best location of the cabins and a reserved area accessible only for YC Members with dedicated restaurant and lounges. A large private pool area with solarium and whirlpool baths. Dedicated massage rooms and full access to Thermal Suite in the MSC Aurea Spa and 24-hour butler service. This is the MSC Yacht Club, a cruise experience like no other. undefined MSC Yacht Club Experience MSC World Europa with the 360º virtual tour Discover the MSC for Me app staterooms & suites MSC World Europa is as different on the inside as she is on the outside. All-new cabin designs are available, and the ship offers more balcony cabins than any other cruise ship in our fleet. In total, the ship has 19 different cabin categories, with 7 brand new designs. From the luxury of the Grand Suite Aurea with an included terrace, to the scenic Infinite Ocean view, to our Deluxe Balcony with promenade view, there’s accommodation for every taste – for couples, families, and all other guests. See more RESTAURANTS & BUFFET The ship will feature 13 dining venues, including an incredible six specialty restaurants, between which the Chef’s Garden Kitchen of Michelin-starred chef Niklas Ekstedt, that offers a menu which focus on the natural ingredients and a farm-to-ocean ethos. Guests also have the opportunity to discover three ample restaurant-buffets on board, each offering their distinct ambiance, including a brand-new location open 24/7. Chef's Garden Kitchen The Chef’s Garden Kitchen promises fresh and seasonal flavors, taking its cues from nature. Born in Sweden, the son of a produce seller, Niklas Ekstedt began his strong connection with nature and the Earth’s flavors at a young age. Modernizing cuisine with art not technology, Ekstedt combines traditional Nordic cooking and preserving techniques with astonishingly creative combinations of rigorously fresh seasonal ingredients. undefined Discover more La Brasserie Buffet Delight in a feast for all your senses at our exquisite buffet, where an exquisite array of delectable dishes from around the world awaits. Indulge in a gastronomic adventure as you savor the flavors, sights, and aromas that will take your taste buds on an unforgettable journey. undefined Pescaderia Our finest Mediterranean seafood restaurant! A delightful fish restaurant that offers a mouth-watering proposal of fish and shellfish made with the freshest ingredients. undefined Luna Park Pizza & Burger Buffet undefined Hexagon Restaurant A delightfully relaxed and cozy dining spot awaits you, offering the finest Mediterranean cuisine with a mesmerizing ocean view. Watch our skilled chefs showcase their culinary expertise while you savor your meal in a casual ambiance. undefined Il Mercato Buffet undefined La Foglia Restaurant In our main restaurant, we offer a unique culinary experience every day. With our exquisite Mediterranean and international specialties and a daily changing menu, we ensure that no two days are the same, providing you with a fresh and exciting dining experience each time. undefined Les Dunes Restaurant Offering exquisite Mediterranean and international specialties and a change of menu everyday means that no two days are the same in our main restaurant. undefined Butcher's Cut Restaurant This American-style steak house serves select Linz heritage angus beef, gold standard in high-end angus beef thanks to the best genetics in breed. The highest quality product custom cut by master butchers and aged to perfection. The menu is inspired by the great plains and it is accompanied by bold New World wines and cocktails with swagger. undefined HOLA! Tacos Cantina The new fast-casual street food dining concept, offers a selection of Latin American and Mexican-inspired dishes and drinks to be shared and enjoyed in a relaxed and friendly atmosphere, open for lunch and dinner. Choose from a tantalizing array of dishes from blue corn tacos and nachos, and tasty tamales through to tortilla soup or vegetarian tacos, all to be savored with our selection of Top 10 Tequilas and Mezcals! undefined Pizza & Burger A wonderfully comfortable and casual place to eat. Watch our chefs at work while you enjoy the best of Mediterranean dining with a spectacular sea view. undefined Kaito Teppanyaki Step in, choose your spot at one of four cooking stations and watch your delicious Japanese dishes come to life, right before your eyes. Our expert chefs cook with flair on an open grill: a feast for the senses that sees flames and the finest sizzling ingredients coming together to form delicious dishes you'll remember forever. undefined Biscayne Bay Restaurant & Buffet undefined MSC Yacht Club Restaurant A private, luxurious restaurant exclusive to MSC Yacht Club Guests, where delectable fresh gourmet menus are created every day and served at your preferred time. undefined Bars & Lounges A wide variety of bars and cafes to match any mood. Peruse her decks, step into the fresh juice bar, settle in for a cup of tea or enjoy a cocktail. Bars and lounges will surprise guests with a strong focus on artisan and craft products. Masters of The Sea The Masters of the Sea pub has long been a favorite spot to grab a quick bite and to delight in the extensive beer list, but this will be the first time that it features an onboard brewery. Award-winning brewmaster Teo Musso, who created the Baladin Farm Brewery, has worked with MSC Cruises to create a bespoke range of MSC signature craft beers that will be brewed at sea in the ship’s full-scale micro-brewery. undefined Elixir Mixology Bar Buzzing with a bright, minimalistic ambience that fills each glass with sparkling light, this temple of Mediterranean mixology is the ideal meeting place to kick off an evening’s fun. But you may well find you linger for longer, tempted and tempted again by the scintillating array of fresh modern cocktail classics. Enticing you further, our expert mixologists and guest famous names specialize in inventing sensational cocktail creations, crafted specially to delight your tastes and mood. Using premium spirits and fresh fruit, plus just-picked herbs and garnishes grown hydroponically in the Chef’s Garden Kitchen next door, the results are an unforgettable explosion of flavors. The experience can be life changing. Elixir by name and elixir by nature! undefined Raj Polo Tea House Step into the elegance of the British Raj to enjoy the quintessential rites and flavors of Empire, all centered on the kingdom’s favorite drink: tea. You’ll find it served here in all its astonishing variety, from tea bags to loose-leaf specialty teas and blooming tea flowers. What’s more, you can be sure to find the perfect brew for every mood, including cold brewed and iced teas, tea-infused cocktails, tea digestive liqueurs, and countless other creative expressions of the art of tea. The wide selection ranges from authentic Earl Grey and Orange Pekoe, full-bodied Assam and muscatel Darjeeling to Spicy Chai and Floral Jasmine, herbal infusions, green teas, white teas and more. Painting a rich picture of Britain’s history of tea, they also tell the story of the East India Company, founded in 1600 during the reign of Queen Elizabeth I. But let’s not forget the food. You’ll dream about the food! All served in period style, it’s in an abundant class of its own, from full English breakfasts to Afternoon Teas with scones, strawberry jam and double clotted cream. Traditional High Tea is served from lunchtime through to late evening and is an altogether more lavish affair, both savory and sweet, that simply has to be experienced! undefined Dolce Vita Bar Apéritif is a French word, which, like its Italian counterpart, aperitivo, comes from the Latin aperire, meaning ‘to open’. The idea behind aperitif is that your appetite is stimulated before a meal. Nowadays, aperitifs are enjoyed at any time and with our handpicked carefully sourced drinks and fresh ingredients we are sure that you will be spoilt for choice. From traditional aperitifs, our Signature Cocktails to the contemporary classics, there is something to suit your taste. If you fancy something different put yourself in the capable hands of our expert bar tenders who will concoct something special just for you. undefined MSC Yacht Club Top Sail Lounge Surround yourself in the lap of luxury and let our artful bar tenders prepare something special for you! With our handpicked carefully sourced drinks and fresh ingredients we are sure that you will be spoilt for choice. From our Signature Cocktails, contemporary classics of Daiquiri’s, Piña Colada’s to soft drinks, beers and hot drinks, there is something to suit your taste. If you fancy something different put yourself in the capable hands of our expert bar tenders who will concoct something special just for you. For the connoisseur there is a handpicked selection of premium drinks available. undefined Coffee Emporium Explore the amazing contrasts between different blends of premium coffee, selected for their quality by coffee masters Lavazza. There’s even a wild bean from the Kafa forests of Ethiopia where coffee began! Add depth to the experience with a learning journey to discover more about what you’re drinking, from the beans themselves to the influence of altitude, terroir and cleaning and drying technique. A selection of choice pastries and biscuits complete the pleasure. Explore, experience and share the joy with your friends! undefined The Box Bar Enjoy the atmosphere of the big game in our unique The Box Bar. The wide and varied choice of cocktails that we carefully selected are sure to quench even the strongest thirst. If you need something to keep you going through the game, you can always get one of our energy drinks. undefined Zen Pool Bar Gaze out over the stunning panorama of the ocean while you sip on a cocktail at the Zen Bar. With our handpicked and carefully sourced drinks and fresh ingredients we are sure that you will be spoilt for choice. From our Signature Cocktails to the contemporary classics of Daiquiri’s and Piña Colada’s there is something to suit your taste. If you fancy something different put yourself in the capable hands of our expert bar tenders who will concoct something special just for you. undefined Botanic Garden Bar Indulge in a lush poolside taste of Eden, refreshing body and soul with a heavenly choice of freshly made drinks, all prepared with premium ingredients, naturally! From Signature Cocktails and coladas to premium beers, soft drinks, coffee and tea, there’s something to bring everyone a paradise moment. undefined The Lanai Bar Let time float by, savoring the moment’s choice of wide selection of whiskies and classic whiskey cocktails, masterfully mixed from superior spirits. Relaxing on plush settees in an elegant club ambience, you’ll feel transported to a timeless realm of pure indulgence, inviting the temptation of a premium cigar. Make your choice from an extensive collection, carefully kept at the perfect temperature and humidity. You can even have us treat it to a brandy mist to further enhance the flavor. Then linger in the moment, rounding it out with select accompaniment. undefined Surfer's Bar Vibrant fun for adults and children of all ages, this on-deck lounger bar is a perfect escape and meeting place. Add sparkle to any moment with its colorful cocktails and fabulous non-alcoholic long drinks, beers, soda floats and freestyle coke machine. When the temperature rises, you’ll love the authentic gelato ice cream in sugar waffle cones, zinged up with your choice of flavorful toppings. undefined The Gin Project Enter a delicious world of history and creation in the Gin Project lounge, a chic grey-brick boutique venue that’s an encyclopedia of gin infusions and cocktails just waiting to be explored and created. Sitting among vintage photographs of gin distilling and the equipment involved, relish the world’s finest gins and most astonishing gin cocktails. There’s nothing better than quaffable holiday memories you’ve created yourself! undefined TV Studio & Bar Entertainment hits a new level in our TV Studio & Bar. Broadcasting live throughout the ship, our TV Studio and radio suite air live games, quizzes, talent contests and other fun content, it also serves as an atmospheric comedy club, karaoke bar and live music venue. Soak up the atmosphere as we broadcast live or join in and unleash your inner star. An excellent selection of cocktails, beer, wine and soft drinks are available to get you ready for your big performance. undefined Zest Juice Bar Zest up your life with fresh-pressed fruit and vegetable juices, smoothies, power shakes, fruit salads and quinoa fruit bowls. Here’s where to grab and go for everything from post workout refueling to vitamin-packed hedonism and detox specials, including a 3-day custom cleanse program. Watch it all being prepared freshly from scratch, then grab and go and…. glow! undefined Fizz - Champagne Bar It is said that Dom Pérignon, monk and cellar master attributed to the discovery of champagne, stated upon his first taste of it - ‘Come quickly, I am tasting the stars!’. Certainly, fine champagne and sparkling wines are charismatic, and have a touch of heaven about them. Our carefully chosen and wide selection of fine champagnes, sparkling wines and champagne cocktails will tantalize your palate. To ensure we have only the best, we have painstakingly researched the quality of our sparkling wines and sourced them from the most renowned producers world-wide. To complement our fine selection of sparkling wines, we have chosen a delectable medley of exquisite seafood to tempt and tease your taste buds. Fresh oysters, shrimps, crab, clams and mussels are prepared to order in front of you by our talented chefs. For the traditionalist, there is, of course, the classic pairing of caviar and fine champagne, a match made in heaven, to spoil yourself with. undefined Jean Philippe Chocolat & Café undefined ITINERARIES Find your MSC World Europa cruises Deckplan Use the deck plans to select your ideal stateroom.
